title: AI Birthday Wisher
tagline: Personalized video birthday wishes generated at scale using AI avatars
description: An automated system that creates personalized birthday video messages for each recipient using AI-generated avatars, custom scripts based on relationship context, and dynamic video composition. Handles 1000+ wishes/day with unique content per person.
problem: Sending personalized birthday wishes at scale is impossible manually. Generic mass messages feel impersonal and damage relationships. Existing tools only do text/email, not video. Video production per person takes 5+ minutes.
solution: End-to-end pipeline: 1) Contact ingestion (CSV/CRM sync) with relationship metadata, 2) Script generator (GPT-4) creates unique message per person using context (how you know them, shared memories, inside jokes), 3) Avatar selector matches persona to relationship type, 4) Video synthesis (HeyGen/D-ID API) with lip-sync, 5) Delivery via WhatsApp/Email/SMS with tracking.
architecture: Serverless functions on AWS Lambda: Ingestion → Context Enrichment (OpenAI) → Script Generation (GPT-4 with few-shot) → Avatar Selection (rule-based + ML) → Video Generation (HeyGen API async) → Delivery Queue (SQS + SES/Twilio) → Analytics Dashboard (Next.js + PostHog). Cost: ~$0.15/video at scale.
